text.description_html:
Don-Jo A2SS, 3-3/8" x 1-1/4" Adjustable Strike Plate for Keyed Knobs or Levers

This Adjustable Strike allows you to adjust the latching point of your door's keyed lever or knob. The Adjustable Security Strike For Key-In-Knob Lock is great for use where the door is warped or the frame is not level. It is an easy solution to stop a door from rattling because you can get the door to sit tight against the door jam. It is made out of 13 gauge steel and is available in brass or silver finishes. For use on residential or commercial applications.

Specifications of the Adjustable Security Strike:

  • Length: 3-3/8"
  • Width Overall Including Lip: 1-13/16"
  • Strike Thickness: 13 gauge (.095)
  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Optional Brass Plated or Silver Painted.
  • Screws: (2) #8 x 2" FHSMS.
  • Don-Jo A2SS Adjustable Security Strike Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
